variants.user_notes: Programming through the USB bootloader needs the board in its bootloader (DFU) mode; on many boards, hold its button while plugging it in.
variants.maintainer_notes: Memory flash: Fomu's bootloader (foboot) stores the design in flash, but the board starts its bootloader at power-up, so whether the design comes back by itself is to check on hardware.

requires.name: usb_dp
requires.why: Disconnects the board from the computer's USB, which would otherwise try to talk to a design without a USB stack.

source.ref: github.com/im-tomu/fomu-workshop hdl/verilog/blink/blink.v and pcf/fomu-pvt.pcf (af55dff): "Assign USB pins to 0 so as to disconnect Fomu from the host system"
